scenes.title: The Wanderer’s First Steps
scenes.rationale: The opening recap and character reflections establish the same cockpit situation in which the party learns coordinated control; the practice continues until an outside summons changes their objective.
scenes.overview: The four learn to see, walk, and explore the shallows through the Wanderer.
scenes.transitionToNext: Oru summons them to a vessel that has crashed near the Dark Lady.

scenes.title: Visitors from Beyond the Storm
scenes.rationale: At the user’s direction, the meeting, offer of sanctuary, warning, and immediate preparations remain one continuous encounter with the visitors; the next scene starts with the battle.
scenes.overview: Aksha and Shai greet the dragonets as Firstborn and receive an offer of sanctuary; their warning sends the islanders into shelter as a dreadnought arrives.
scenes.transitionToNext: The dreadnought launches fighters and the coordinated defense begins.

scenes.title: The Wanderer Against the Dreadnought
scenes.rationale: All four tactical phases belong to one continuous battle, with the same immediate goal, allied cast, and battlefield; the shield breach and new powers do not create separate recap situations.
scenes.overview: The four combine spells, statue powers, and a giant stone maul to defeat the attackers, while the village is damaged and the allied craft falls.
scenes.transitionToNext: With the battle over, Tony rushes to the travelers’ wreck to help them.

scenes.title: Rescue from the Wreck
scenes.rationale: At the user’s direction, triage at the travelers’ wreck and the rescue from the dreadnought form one closing aftermath sequence, connected by Tony’s discovery of the captive life signatures.
scenes.overview: Aksha cannot be revived, but Shai survives; the party saves many captives and eggs before the dreadnought explodes, then hears Shai’s warning that they must leave.
